text:
**A 1,000–1,200 Wh power station is a good starting point for one blanket overnight.** I’d look at the **BLUETTI AC180**: it has a 1,152 Wh battery and an 1,800 W AC output, and one comparison estimates it can run a single 120 V blanket all night ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/power-station-to-run-a-heated-blanket-all-night)).

Runtime depends a lot on the blanket’s wattage and heat setting. As a rough guide, a 1,024 Wh station is estimated to run a 100 W blanket for about eight hours ([Tested Watts](https://testedwatts.com/2026/09/24/power-station-electric-blanket/)). If you want more margin, use a high setting, or also power other devices, consider a **2,000 Wh-class** station.

Check your blanket’s label, and plug it directly into the station rather than an extension cord or power strip.
